integrity: The proof is symbolic. The upper bound constructs an explicit chain extension from the edge-disjoint cycle blocks; the lower bound quantifies over every chain extension and every cointegral basis and uses the integral coordinate norm of a shortest cycle. No experimental enumeration is used as a proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected simple cactus graphs with \(b_1(X)\ge2\). It does not determine algebraic gnarledness for graphs with overlapping cycles, does not provide a general algorithm, and does not claim marking-independence.
title: Reciprocal-girth gnarledness for multi-cycle cactus graphs
